logline: 평생 장을 돌아온 늙은 장돌뱅이가 달밤 산길에서 젊은 동행에게 옛일을 꺼낸다.
destination: 밤 개울 — 그가 젊은이의 등에 업히게 되는 자리
setting: 1930년대 강원도 봉평 장터와 대화 가는 밤 산길
anchor: an elderly peddler with a wispy beard in worn hemp jacket leading a small pack donkey, Korean mountain road
palette: full-moon silver, buckwheat white, deep night blue, warm lantern speck

beats.beat: 장이 파하자 두 장돌뱅이가 짐을 꾸린다.
beats.visual: two peddlers tying bundles onto a small donkey in an emptying market at dusk, stalls folding behind
beats.motion: rope is pulled tight, the donkey shifts weight, stall cloth flaps down

beats.beat: 늙은 장돌뱅이가 젊은 동행과 밤길에 오른다.
beats.visual: an elderly peddler and a young man walking a narrow mountain path at night, donkey between them
beats.motion: the donkey's hooves find the path, lantern light bobs, their breath clouds

beats.beat: 달빛에 메밀밭이 소금을 뿌린 듯 희다.
beats.visual: a vast buckwheat field in full white bloom under a huge moon, a thin path cutting through it
beats.motion: the whole field ripples in one slow wave, petals lift, the moon holds still

beats.beat: 그는 젊은 시절 물방앗간 이야기를 꺼낸다.
beats.visual: an elderly peddler talking as he walks, an old timber water mill glimpsed far below the path
beats.motion: his hand gestures as he speaks, the mill wheel turns far below, grass sways

beats.beat: 젊은이가 제 어머니 이야기를 꺼내 놓는다.
beats.visual: a young peddler walking with his head down, the elderly man turning to look at him, moonlit path
beats.motion: the old man's head turns sharply, the young man keeps walking, dust rises

beats.visual: an elderly peddler stumbling into a shallow moonlit stream, water splashing up around his knees
beats.motion: water bursts upward, he pitches sideways, the donkey rears back

beats.visual: a young man carrying an elderly peddler on his back across a shallow stream, water at his shins
beats.motion: water ripples around his legs, the old man's arms tighten, the stream glitters

beats.beat: 그가 젊은이의 왼손을 본다면 무엇을 알게 될까?
beats.visual: a young man's left hand gripping a rein in moonlight, an elderly face turned toward it behind
beats.motion: the rein shifts in the left hand, the old man's eyes widen, moonlight steadies

withheld: 동행이 물방앗간 여인의 아들일 수 있다는 암시
